_note: M1 test values only. Launch values are TBA and set by the owner (SPEC 13).
_guard_note: Guard limits on non-target metrics (SPEC 10.1 rule 6, owner 2026-10-11): guard_max_regression is the default max regression (a fraction) seeding guard config version 1; guard_activation_ms 0 = active from Core's first start with this code. Later edits and per-recipe overrides: POST /v1/admin/guard-config.
_features_note: Feature flags, default off (docs/plans/AGENT-POOLS.md 2, GITHUB-FEE-CLAIMS.md 2): Core serves no pool or fee-claim route and runs no keeper or attestor while a flag is false. UNITS_FEATURE_AGENT_POOLS=1 or UNITS_FEATURE_GITHUB_FEE_CLAIMS=1 turns one on for a single process (a staging Core). The onchain switch is separate: LaunchConfig.features, admin set_features.

prepay._note: Plan C, TEST values: the dollar to $UNITS rate is a TEST rate until $UNITS exists; compute prices mirror the site runtime's config (scripts/deploy/site-config.ts) and the runtime checks they match at start. identity_account_*: the price of A units account (0.05 SOL, owner 2026-10-11) and its recipient, the devnet $UNITS treasury key (scripts/devnet/devnet.json pump_tline.treasury); both admin-editable via POST /v1/admin/launch-fronting.
